title: Habitat 0
lede: A cluster of weekend homes planned around shared greens, where each house opens to its own private garden and an unhurried pace.
body: Conceived as a small community of weekend homes, Habitat 0 balances privacy with a generous shared landscape. Each unit is oriented to its own pocket of garden, while planted courts and shaded walks stitch the houses together.
A restrained palette of local materials lets the architecture recede into the site, so that planting and the changing light do the work of giving each home its character.

seo.title: Habitat 0
seo.description: A cluster of weekend homes planned around shared greens, where each house opens to its own private garden and an unhurried pace.

title: Saanvi Nirman Marketing Office
lede: A compact marketing office designed to feel calm and considered, shaping a buyer's first impression of the development.
body: The brief was to translate a developer's ambition into a small but memorable space. Daylight, a quiet material palette and a clear circulation spine give the office an unhurried, gallery-like quality.
Built-in seating and a central display anchor the room, while a softened threshold eases the move in from the busy street outside.

seo.title: Saanvi Nirman Marketing Office
seo.description: A compact marketing office designed to feel calm and considered, shaping a buyer's first impression of the development.

title: The Villa
lede: A 3-star resort of 12,000 sq.m in Bhuj, drawn from the slope of the site as a sequence of stepped terraces.
body: The Villa spreads across 12,000 sq.m. The arrival is accentuated by three landscape elements: a boulevard, a stepped garden, and an arrival plaza with sand-finished walls and a central water feature.

The concept grew from the sloping terrain of the site, read as a series of stepped terraces. An amphitheatre anchors the central space and opens generous outdoor space to the rooms. Each setback becomes an altered terrace with semi-covered seating and lush lawns, connecting guests with one another and making the centre a place of congregation.

seo.title: The Villa
seo.description: A 3-star resort of 12,000 sq.m in Bhuj, drawn from the slope of the site as a sequence of stepped terraces.

title: Farmhouse at Shilpgram
lede: A 5,000 sq.m landscape beside a farmhouse, where a flat plot is reworked into raised gardens on shifting levels.
body: An outdoor landscape for recreation and active leisure, spanning 5,000 sq.m, sits alongside a farmhouse on a flat plot. Because the terrain is level, raised gardens on different levels were introduced to give the site depth and variety.

A swimming pool, visible from the building, anchors the space, with a sunken seating area beside it. A zig-zag flooring pattern carried throughout lends the design a unity and character entirely its own.

seo.title: Farmhouse at Shilpgram
seo.description: A 5,000 sq.m landscape beside a farmhouse, where a flat plot is reworked into raised gardens on shifting levels.

title: Seasons Apartment
lede: A shared landscape for an apartment community, shaped around everyday movement, pause and gathering.
body: Built from a compact footprint, the landscape unfolds as a varied ground plane. Shaded seating sits beneath a hardy, year-round canopy, while clear paths connect the towers and bring the garden into daily life.
Layered planting keeps the commons green through the seasons with a considered, low-maintenance palette.

seo.title: Seasons Apartment
seo.description: A shared landscape for an apartment community, shaped around everyday movement, pause and gathering.

title: Swati Parkside Apartment
lede: A parkside residential landscape that draws the green edge of the site into the daily life of its residents.
body: Walkways, seating courts and play areas are woven between the blocks, so every household is a short walk from something green.
Level changes and planted buffers screen the parking and services, making the garden, not the car park, the first thing residents meet on arrival.

seo.title: Swati Parkside Apartment
seo.description: A parkside residential landscape that draws the green edge of the site into the daily life of its residents.

title: Corporate Office Landscape
lede: A working landscape for a corporate campus, designed to make both the arrival and the breaks between work feel restorative.
body: The scheme frames the approach with a generous forecourt and shaded seating, turning leftover setbacks into usable outdoor rooms for informal meetings and quiet breaks.
A simple, durable material palette and structured planting keep the campus legible and easy to maintain through the year.

seo.title: Corporate Office Landscape
seo.description: A working landscape for a corporate campus, designed to make both the arrival and the breaks between work feel restorative.

title: Roseate Roots
lede: Weekend homes set into their landscape, where the garden is treated as the first room of the house.
body: Each home is planned around its outdoor space, with covered thresholds and filtered light easing the move from built form to garden.
Native, low-care planting and local stone root the houses in their setting and let them weather gracefully.

seo.title: Roseate Roots
seo.description: Weekend homes set into their landscape, where the garden is treated as the first room of the house.

title: Shades of Nature
lede: A private residence where architecture and garden share one geometry, softening the line between inside and out.
body: The lines of the house are extended into the landscape, with niches, water and planting picking up the rhythm of the built form.
A lily pond, semi-open seating and a trellised verandah create a gentle sequence of thresholds from the rooms to the open garden.

seo.title: Shades of Nature
seo.description: A private residence where architecture and garden share one geometry, softening the line between inside and out.

title: Karnav Patel Farmhouse
lede: A farmhouse landscape made for slow weekends, organised around water, shade and long open views.
body: Raised lawns, a pool court and shaded decks give the flat plot a layered, unhurried character.
A restrained palette of local stone and timber ties the outdoor rooms to the house and to the land around it.

seo.title: Karnav Patel Farmhouse
seo.description: A farmhouse landscape made for slow weekends, organised around water, shade and long open views.
